subject: The account field Apollo can't sell you
body:
Newsletter coverage is an account field no data vendor sells you: which publications wrote about a company, which sponsors buy space in those lists, and whether the publication is gaining readers.

NewsletterFIT derives it from the newsletter ecosystem with AI, returning publications, sponsors, brands, people, topics, mentions and momentum per account, each with its source URL and date.

The contrast is visible in our graph. Apollo appears in 102 articles across 88 publications, ZoomInfo in 25 across 19, Ocean.io not at all.

For a ranking product the join is the test. I can send a sample keyed by domain so you can score it against accounts you already rank, over REST ([DOCS_LINK]) or MCP ([MCP_LINK]).
